NORAD ID: 38708
Int'l Code: 2012-039B
Launch date: July 22, 2012
Source: Belarus (BELA)
Launch site: TYURATAM MISSILE AND SPACE COMPLEX (TTMTR)

The BKA satellite is a Belarusian satellite analogue of the Canopus-B, a satellite designed for remote sensing of the Earth. It weighs about 400 kilograms and it is to work on a circular orbit at a height of 510 km.
